Undergraduate Catalog » University Policies and Procedures » Undergraduate Academic Policies » Degree Policies » Degree Requirements

# Degree Requirements

In the degree programs listed below, if professional credits are more than 10 years old, a Demonstration of Currency (DOC) is required:

  * Bachelor of Science (Science and Technology)
  * Associate in Science (Science and Technology)

For Bachelor of Science in Business Administration (BS/BSBA) degree areas of study and undergraduate business certificates, 50 percent of the courses may be older than 10 years from the most current date of application to the University and still apply toward the area of study. The remaining area of study credits must be current, completed within 10 years of the most current date of application to the University. Within the BSBA Professional Business Requirements, the Business Administration Capstone course has a currency limitation of no more than five years old in order to apply toward the Professional Business Requirements requirement. If the course is older than five years, students are required to retake the current version of the course.

University Area of Study Upper-Level Degree Policy

Baccalaureate students must complete a minimum of 18 credits at the upper level (3000 level or higher) within the area of study, which includes the Capstone course.

School of Business and Management Upper-Level Degree Policy

Baccalaureate students must complete a minimum of 18 credits at the upper level (3000 level or higher). These 18 credits will include 12 upper-level credits in the area of study, the Capstone, and one additional 3 credit upper-level course, which can be completed in the area of study or the Professional Business Requirements.
